implementation.records: Blocks are directional persistent friendship records. The service removes prior friendship/request state, emits explicit blocker and target identities, and keeps blocked-state probing non-disclosing.
implementation.enforcement: DM sends perform a bidirectional block check and friend-request creation detects block records server-side.
implementation.management: The authenticated list returns real user rows. The client supports case-insensitive name/username search, pages twenty rows at a time with Show more, and removes one row after a successful unblock.
implementation.single_effect: Only the blocker may unblock. After deletion, repeating the operation returns not-found instead of reporting a second success.

blocked_verification: Windows Application Control blocked the newly generated Go services and handlers test executables. This is recorded as missing runtime evidence, not a pass.
remaining_acceptance: Use two browser clients to block, search, expand, unblock once and verify message, call and friend-request restrictions on both clients.
